scenarios.reason: Executed the real parent wrapper and SSH job worker with an owned synthetic registration; matching-generation replacement refused its fm-lab-* route before endpoint access. Read-only helper calls reached theshop and mama, but the helper refused fm-remote provisioning. The controller requires fm-remote and cannot target an owned lab; source changes are forbidden by the preserve-head decision. Provide an approved named-lab controller path and remote scratch authority within the workspace boundary.

The controller rejected the fm-lab-* route before teardown, and every fixture file remained unchanged. Existing remote fm-remote sessions cannot be used under the mandatory named-lab contract. Provide the same approved named-lab controller path and remote scratch authority; cleanup success cannot be inferred from this refusal.
